verdict.rationale: GitLab documents its own self-managed deployment options (Linux package, Docker images, Helm chart/Operator, self-compile), so customers can run the instance on infrastructure they choose and control where their data lives. Community users also value choosing between GitLab.com and a self-run instance. However, the evidence never documents region or residency selection for the hosted GitLab.com service, so residency control comes only through self-hosting. Missing for 10: documented region/data-residency selection for hosted GitLab.com, explicit residency or compliance documentation, independent corroboration of residency guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: The Linux package includes services and tools to install GitLab without laborious configuration.
we recommend the Helm chart or the Operator for installing cloud-native GitLab.
They value being able to use either GitLab.com or a self-run instance.
